
---
title: "Instacart Shopping Patterns"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: scroll
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)

data("instacart", package = "p8105.datasets")

department_counts =
  instacart |>
  count(department, name = "product_records") |>
  mutate(
    department = fct_reorder(department, product_records)
  )

order_records =
  instacart |>
  distinct(order_id, order_hour_of_day, order_dow)

hourly_orders =
  order_records |>
  count(order_hour_of_day, name = "num_orders") |>
  arrange(order_hour_of_day)

order_sizes =
  instacart |>
  count(order_id, order_dow, name = "num_products") |>
  mutate(
    order_dow = factor(order_dow, levels = 0:6)
  )
```

Column
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Product records by department {data-height=600}

```{r}
department_counts |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~product_records,
    y = ~department,
    type = "bar",
    orientation = "h"
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Number of product records"),
    yaxis = list(title = "", automargin = TRUE)
  )
```

### Orders by hour of day {data-height=450}

```{r}
hourly_orders |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~order_hour_of_day,
    y = ~num_orders,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "lines+markers"
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Hour of day", dtick = 6),
    yaxis = list(title = "Number of orders")
  )
```

### Products per order by day of week {data-height=600}

```{r}
order_sizes |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~order_dow,
    y = ~num_products,
    type = "box"
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Day of week (dataset code)"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Number of products per order")
  )
```
